input: Get a biomechanics assessment before my next marathon

gold.taskTitle: Get a Biomechanics Assessment Before Next Marathon
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and complete a biomechanics assessment in preparation for an upcoming marathon.

questions.title: When exactly is your next marathon?
questions.description: Identify the specific date of the upcoming marathon to establish a deadline for completing the assessment.

questions.title: Have you had a biomechanics assessment before?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has prior experience with biomechanics assessments to tailor the search and preparation advice.

questions.title: What is prompting you to get this assessment?
questions.description: Understand the core reason — injury prevention, recurring pain, performance improvement, or gait inefficiency — to find the right specialist.

questions.title: Do you have a specific injury or pain point currently?
questions.description: Identify any existing physical issue that the assessment should specifically address.

questions.title: What city or area should the provider be in?
questions.description: Establish the user's location to narrow down local clinics, sports labs, or physiotherapists who offer biomechanics assessments.

questions.title: Do you have a budget in mind for this assessment?
questions.description: Understand financial constraints to filter options ranging from basic gait analysis at running stores to full clinical assessments.

questions.title: Should the provider also give a follow-up action plan?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants just the assessment data or also expects corrective recommendations, drills, or shoe advice as an output.
